correctionOfRevision1: Revision 1 disposed Serializing_a_protocol_buffer_message as REMOVED_WITH_DECIDED_COMPONENT. That was wrong on its own terms: it concluded from one measurement of the current product configuration that the capability belonged to the removed library, without asking whether the kept path can deliver it. It can.

rows.reason: Attribute and converter base type belong to the removed library; the subject is the removed item.
Kept as a representative compatibility contract, together with its two proto sources and the generated test types. It is not a bus serializer and adds no product dependency.
rows.howItWasMadeGreen: A JsonObjectCreationHandling.Populate attribute on a partial declaration of the generated test type, inside the test project.
rows.whyNotTheGlobalOption: Setting PreferredObjectCreationHandling on the product options would change how the bus deserializes every property everywhere. The whole core suite stayed green under it, but a green suite is not a proof that nothing changed: it has no case for the opposite direction, a property whose collection is already filled and would then be appended to instead of replaced. The local attribute needs no such argument.
rows.mutation: Removing the attribute turns the case red again.
